body:
**Tier: T4 (money movement: Stripe charges, voids, cancels).** S-DUNNING v2 backend: native card update (OR-110-2), 1A auto-charge, 2A cancel, dunning cadence Day 0/1/3/7 with a 10-day lockout.

Never merge from an agent. Migration name stays `20270215000000_dunning_billing_actions`. Main merged in as a merge commit (no rebase): `e5a6044a` (env registration per #624 respected: no new env reads; `STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` was already registered).

## R3 fix round (all A/B findings from both lenses, plus the C items)

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing before) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-628-1 paid-before-list cancel ended a just-paid period | Cancel re-reads the subscription and its open invoices from Stripe inside the action (under the fenced lease); a payment that landed first means option A: cancel at period end, `paid_period_kept: true`, nothing voided. Idempotent on repeat. | 739e9a54 | `test/dunning-r3-money-truth-e2e.spec.ts` "B-628-1" (3 cases) |
| B-628-2 "nothing was charged" after a partial success | Per-plan, per-invoice integer-cent results; `paid_totals` / `due_totals` per currency; message leads with what went through; `access_state` restored, partial, updating or unchanged. | 739e9a54 | "B-628-2/3" (4 cases) |
| B-628-3 shown amount differs from charged; currencies summed | `GET /v1/checkout/payment-method/quote` lists every open invoice; confirm charges only `approved_invoices` that match id, amount and currency; anything new or changed returns `approval_required` with a fresh quote and is not charged. Single `amount_*_cents` only when one currency, otherwise null. | 739e9a54 | "B-628-2/3", http table |
| B-628-4 silent pagination truncation | `listOpenInvoices` uses `limit=100`, follows `has_more`/`starting_after` (10 pages max) and throws `invoice_list_incomplete` / `invoice_list_malformed` (502) instead of returning a partial list. | 739e9a54 | `test/dunning-r2-surfaces.spec.ts` pagination (11 invoices, malformed, incomplete) |
| B-628-5 / C-628-4 void before durable cancel intent | `ClientBillingOperation` journal row (intent) is written before any void; a failed or lost void leaves the intent for the reconciler; `CANCEL_INCOMPLETE` (4xx) or `PLAN_CHANGE_RESULT_UNKNOWN` (lost answer). Stale `customer.subscription.updated` during a pending client cancel is ignored (`stale_during_client_cancel`). | 739e9a54 | "B-628-5" + webhook stale case |
| B-628-6 notices not durable; permanent dedupe keys | `DunningNoticeDelivery` outbox written in the same transaction as the step claim; per-channel results; retry backoff 15m/1h/4h/12h, dead after 6; keys scoped per cycle (`dunning_v2:{state}:{cycle}:email:{step}` + `:r{attempt}`). | 739e9a54 | "B-628-6" (2 cases) |
| B-628-7 comp/live-grant parity | `dunning-effective-access.ts` (`hasOtherLiveAccess`, `effectiveLock`) shared by the guard and the client status (`lock_waived`). | 739e9a54 | "B-628-7" |
| B-628-8 dispute cycle never locked / resolved with zero settlement | Dispute cycles lock on schedule regardless of subscription state; a paid invoice or card update does not clear an open dispute cycle; `charge.dispute.closed` resolves it (won clears; lost stays for support). | 739e9a54 | "B-628-8" |
| B-628-9 lease not a fence | `ClientBillingLease` with a fencing token; every money write runs in a transaction that compare-and-sets the holder token first; a stalled holder gets `409 BILLING_ACTION_IN_PROGRESS`, never a second write. | 739e9a54 | "B-628-9" |
| B-628-10 production filter drops the phase; validation without codes | Phase is carried by stable codes the filter keeps: `PAYMENT_RESULT_UNKNOWN`, `PLAN_CHANGE_RESULT_UNKNOWN`, `CANCEL_INCOMPLETE`, `STRIPE_UNAVAILABLE` (only when nothing changed). | 739e9a54 | `test/dunning-r3-http-codes.spec.ts` "B-628-10" over real HTTP with `HttpExceptionFilter` |
| C-628-1 requires_action without re-reading status | Re-read the PaymentIntent and invoice before reporting; 3DS already completed reports `paid`. | 739e9a54 | "C-628-1" in money-truth spec |
| C-628-2 empty publishable key | 503 `PAYMENTS_NOT_CONFIGURED` before any Stripe call when the key is empty or the wrong mode. | 739e9a54 | http-codes "C-628-2" |
| C-628-3 uncoded 400s | Param-level pipes: `INVALID_BILLING_REQUEST` (names the field) and `INVALID_PLAN_ID`. | 739e9a54 | http-codes "C-628-3" (3 cases) |

Failing-before: the R3 specs exercise behaviour and APIs that do not exist at the R2 head `ba1d9480` (quote route, approval, lease table, outbox, dispute close), so they fail there by construction; no separate red run was recorded.

## Worked money examples

1. **1A full.** One open $150.00 invoice. Quote `totals=[{usd,15000}]`, client approves `in_1/15000/usd`. Confirm pays 15000. Response `outcome=paid, amount_paid_cents=15000, paid_totals=[{usd,15000}], access_state=restored`.
2. **1A partial, two plans.** Plan 1 $150.00 paid. Plan 2 invoice list returns 503. Response `outcome=payment_uncertain` (or `failed` on a 4xx), `paid_totals=[{usd,15000}]`, `access_state=partial`, message "Your card ending 4242 is saved. $150.00 went through..." Never "nothing was charged".
3. **2A ended.** In dunning, open $150.00. Intent row written, invoice voided, subscription canceled now. `outcome=ended, voided_amount_cents=15000` (forgiven, never collected), access ends now.
4. **2A, paid before list (option A).** Stripe's retry paid the invoice a moment before the cancel. Re-read inside the action sees no open invoice and a paid period: `outcome=scheduled, paid_period_kept=true, voided_amount_cents=0`, access to period end, no refund.
5. **Voluntary cancel outside dunning.** `outcome=scheduled`, access to period end, no refund, nothing voided.
6. **Mixed currency.** Open eur 8000 and usd 15000. Quote `totals=[{eur,8000},{usd,15000}]` (alphabetical, never summed). Confirm pays both: `paid_totals` the same, `amount_paid_cents=null`, `currency=null`.

## Tests (via `ops/heavy.sh`, `--runInBand`)

See the R3 report for the exact commands and results. `tsc --noEmit` once this round.

## Owner decisions queued

- The Stripe webhook endpoint must subscribe to `charge.dispute.closed` (recommended default: add it at deploy).
- A lost dispute stays with support in v1.0 (recommended default).
- A replayed confirm reports the amount the first confirm paid; an invoice Stripe had already paid before our call reports 0 for that line but the plan as settled.
